mapper.select: SELECT d.equip_code, COUNT(*) AS sample_count, AVG(CAST(d.spindle_vibration AS FLOAT)) AS vibration_mean, STDEV(CAST(d.spindle_vibration AS FLOAT)) AS vibration_sigma, AVG(CAST(d.spindle_temp AS FLOAT)) AS temp_mean, STDEV(CAST(d.spindle_temp AS FLOAT)) AS temp_sigma FROM equipment_data d JOIN equipment e ON e.equip_code = d.equip_code WHERE e.auto_collect = 'Y' AND d.status = 'RUN' AND d.collected_at >= #{from} AND d.collected_at < #{to} AND d.spindle_vibration IS NOT NULL AND d.spindle_temp IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.equip_code ORDER BY d.equip_code
